title: Toolchain versions
description: The versions this workspace is built against. Consumed by MODULE.bazel, the Dockerfile, CI and `carbon doctor` — all four must agree, and .tools/validation/check_workspace.py checks that they do.

toolchains.description: Compilers and runtimes installed into the environment.

libraries.description: Bazel modules. Every key must match a bazel_dep version in MODULE.bazel.

version.description: An exact version. Ranges are deliberately not allowed: this file is what CI provisions, and a range makes two machines disagree while both claim to be correct.
